_meta.purpose: Shared ground truth for whether a calendar product carries holidays, and which locale's. The print decides in backend/django/services/calendar_layout.py (materialize_surfaces loads holidays only when calendar.holidaySource is an object with a truthy 'enabled', defaulting the locale to 'generic'); the customer preview decides with printedHolidayLocale in frontend/nextjs/src/lib/calendar.ts. If either side drifts, the customer previews holiday dots the print will not carry (or misses ones it will). 'calendar' is the layout's calendar block; null means the layout has none. expectedLocale null means no holidays. 'showInCells' is a retired ops setting that nothing reads; stored layouts may still carry it, and it must never change the answer.

cases.name: a stored showInCells false still carries holidays (retired, never read)
switched off keeps its locale but loads nothing
enabled with no locale falls back to generic, not en-IN
enabled with an empty locale falls back to generic
block without an enabled flag loads nothing
no calendar block at all loads nothing
